title: The Hidden Father and the Land of Light
summary: A turning inward to the inmost Divine itself: how Greatness names the bearing realm of every Father at every discrete degree; the First Father's Five Members and the Five Attributes that gush forth from him into the aeons; the Land of Light in its perfect order, where the rich gods are summoned and established; and the unchanging stillness of Eternity, the Divine Esse before and beyond all process. The section steps back from cosmic operations to contemplate what the Lord is in his own substance.
organizing_principle: Contemplative inward turn to the inmost Divine — Father (interior structure), Land of Light (celestial state), Eternity (unchanging ground) — moving from the source-pole, through its outermost expression, to the timeless stillness underlying both.
